# Math Mammoth

> Math Mammoth provides affordable, quality math curricula and worktexts for homeschoolers and schools, emphasizing conceptual understanding and mastery-oriented learning from grades 1-8.

Math Mammoth offers multiple curriculum series including the complete Light Blue Series, topical Blue Series worktexts, and localized versions for Canada, South Africa, and international markets. The site provides free resources like placement tests and instructional videos alongside comprehensive documentation and customer support.

## Core Curriculum Series

- [Math Mammoth Light Blue Series - Complete Curriculum Grades 1-8](https://www.mathmammoth.com/complete-curriculum): Complete Light Blue Series curriculum overview for grades 1-8
- [Math Mammoth Blue Series - Topical Worktexts](https://www.mathmammoth.com/blue-series): Blue Series topical worktexts for supplemental and remedial math covering addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, fractions, decimals, and more
- [Which Math Mammoth Books Should You Choose?](https://www.mathmammoth.com/books): Guide to choosing between Math Mammoth series and product lines
- [Math Mammoth Bundle Packages and Pricing](https://www.mathmammoth.com/packages): Discounted bundle packages and pricing options for Math Mammoth products including Blue Series, Light Blue Series, and All-Inclusive packages

## Regional Curriculum Versions

- [Math Mammoth International Version](https://www.mathmammoth.com/international/international): Math Mammoth International version with metric and British English for grades 1-7
- [Math Mammoth Canadian Version](https://www.mathmammoth.com/canada): Math Mammoth Canadian version curriculum for grades 1-8
- [Math Mammoth South African Version](https://www.mathmmammoth.com/south_africa): Math Mammoth South African localized curriculum for grades 1-7

## Supplemental Materials and Workbooks

- [Math Mammoth Skills Review Workbooks](https://www.mathmammoth.com/skills_review_workbooks): Skills review workbooks for spiral review practice and retention
- [Foundational Word Problems Workbook](https://www.mathmammoth.com/word_problems/foundational_word_problems): Foundational Word Problems workbook for teaching problem-solving strategies
- [Make It Real Learning - Real-World Mathematics](https://www.mathmammoth.com/mirl): Make It Real Learning real-world applied mathematics workbooks
